import griffe

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience entry point
module = griffe.load("requests")

# Collect and print all public top-level functions
public_functions = [
    name for name, member in module.members.items()
    if not name.startswith('_') and isinstance(member, griffe.Function)
]

for func_name in sorted(public_functions):
    print(func_name)
